question: Why does a mother not abandon a son even when he is covered by repeated offenses?
premises: A son may be covered by a series of offenses
A mother is the subject of the action
A mother does not disregard her son
inference: Even when a son is enveloped in repeated offenses, a mother does not disregard him.
plain_english: Indeed, a mother does not disregard a son even when he is covered by a series of offenses.
